title: N01 global energy-shape trend relearning and historical replay
model_changes: Reuse existing1D U-Net and FiLM; make mean conditioning, decoder and mean head trainable for a separately registered run; preserve originalA0 as comparison, not immutable signal path.

Retain monotone charge branch. Add a smooth low-dimensional log-source-Q trend representation to condition tail/width/rise and the trainable waveform path; penalize artificial energy oscillations with fixed shape input.
Train energy-and-shape-dependent stochastic response covariance/basis after useful mean trend recovery. Keep response variation separate from electronics.

retain: raw SOURCE waveform and its normalized full shape
learned shape embedding and explicit tail fraction/rise/FWHM summaries
physics_if_verified: interaction/position metadata only if actually available and physically valid

losses: Existing full-waveform and joint hard-observable objectives.
Additional soft output-Q conditional distribution loss for PSD, rise, width and charge-shape relationships, covering all energy regions.
Conditional mean/quantile/width trend losses; full conditional distribution remains required for multimodal PSD.
Smooth energy variation regularization; no blanket monotonic PSD assumption.
Keep original physical and noise protections and scientific acceptance; local old algorithm radius is not a scientific physical threshold.
population_contract: No event pairing or physical-energy equality is created from equal numerical SOURCE/REAL Q. No source-population reweighting to hide shape errors. Energy-stratified auxiliary losses retain separate original-population reports.

memory.long_term: Persist trained weights, energy trend parameters and normalization statistics.
memory.replay: Replay actual historical TRAIN SOURCE and REAL observations, with energy/shape/condition coverage; current mistaken model output is not a teacher.
memory.current_scale: Current TRAIN-role data are small enough to retain all6,465 source parents and18,948 REAL rows; later bound the replay store by coverage-aware sampling with sampling weights recorded.
memory.future: New acquisition groups remain forward tests before updates; update with mixed historical/new data and report retention separately.
memory.sequence: Current events are independent; do not introduce chronological dependence between unrelated pulses.
memory.storage: Frequently read training/replay data stay on local or compute storage; large archival versions go toNAS.

validation: Keep original source-parent and REAL-group holdouts; do not create artificial missing energy ranges.
Evaluate per-output-Q conditional PSD distributions, both bands if present, full-waveform/noise/flags, and original scientific success gates.
Sweep amplitude continuously for fixed source shapes as an engineering trend diagnostic; verify branch continuity and excessive curvature without forcing PSD monotonicity.
Use new acquisition groups to establish future-data performance; covered-range interpolation and out-of-range extrapolation are reported separately.
execution_order: Close current53-parameter fixed-restoration route as insufficient for overall PSD matching.
Implement one energy-conditioned mean-relearning configuration, freeze its data roles, objective, budget and stop rules before running.
Continue to conditional stochastic training only when mean trends and physical protections improve.
Use retained historical data in every later update; perform no hyperparameter sweep.
